issues.explanation: The same unique-violation detection is implemented twice instead of sharing the trait helper.
The concurrent-grant fallback uses a query-builder update with a pre-encoded JSON string, so updated_at is not refreshed on that rare path.

conventions.evidence: Domain writes via app/Actions/* with Gate authorization (app/Actions/CreateQueue.php:144, app/Actions/UpdateQueue.php:325, app/Actions/SetQueueAccess.php:204); QueuePolicy in app/Policies/QueuePolicy.php:19; reversible migration with down() database/migrations/2026_10_29_120000_create_queue_access_table.php:73; #[Fillable] matching Ticket model app/Models/QueueAccess.php:399; audit channel Log::channel('audit') app/Actions/SetQueueAccess.php:276; docs + CHANGELOG updated

readability.evidence: Clear names (normalizeName, normalizeSlug, assertSlugAvailable, validated, upsert, audit); small focused methods in app/Actions/Concerns/ValidatesQueueAttributes.php:57 and app/Actions/SetQueueAccess.php:236; consistent sibling style, no dead code

requirements.evidence: CreateQueue app/Actions/CreateQueue.php:142 trims/validates name, slugifies default/explicit, is_active=true; duplicate slug ValidationException incl. race app/Actions/Concerns/ValidatesQueueAttributes.php:91; UpdateQueue nullable name:/slug:/isActive: app/Actions/UpdateQueue.php:318 with own-slug allowed; no delete action; SetQueueAccess upsert/revoke + ValidationException + cross-entity check app/Actions/SetQueueAccess.php:198; audit granted/revoked only when deleted app/Actions/SetQueueAccess.php:220; QueuePolicy call with is_array check app/Policies/QueuePolicy.php:548; CallNextTicket Gate after active check app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php:29; Ticket::call lock->inactive->authorize->status app/Models/Ticket.php:463

scope.evidence: Diff touches only CreateQueue, UpdateQueue, SetQueueAccess, trait, enum, QueueAccess model/factory, migration, QueuePolicy, two call paths, docs/business-rules.md, docs/database-schema.md, CHANGELOG.md, and queue tests plus managerOf helper; no unrelated refactors

security.evidence: Gate::forUser authorize before writes in CreateQueue.php:144, UpdateQueue.php:325, SetQueueAccess.php:204, CallNextTicket.php:29, Ticket.php:492; input validation normalizeName/normalizeSlug/validated; corrupted non-array permissions deny via is_array in QueuePolicy.php:570; mass-assignment via #[Fillable]

simplicity.evidence: Shared ValidatesQueueAttributes trait reused by CreateQueue and UpdateQueue, lean actions; minor duplication: isUniqueViolation reimplemented in app/Actions/SetQueueAccess.php:285 instead of reusing the trait

review.summary: Implements queue lifecycle, per-queue call grants with audit, QueuePolicy, and call-path enforcement with docs and comprehensive Pest tests. Only trivial nits remain (duplicated unique-violation helper, stale timestamp on the race fallback), so the pull request is approvable as is.
